name: labs/plasmon360__python_newport_1918_powermeter
title: Newport 1918-C optical power meter (newport_1918c.Newport_1918c)
intro: Newport 1918-C optical power meter (newport_1918c.Newport_1918c), adapted from plasmon360/python_newport_1918_powermeter. It reads `serial_number` and `model_number`; sets `wavelength_nm`; runs `measure_intensity`. `measure_intensity`: measure optical or radiant intensity at a declared wavelength or channel and return the value with its unit and integration time. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
